title: CSCI 420 — Principles of Data Mining
subject: Data Science and Analytics
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the knowledge discovery process and distinguish descriptive data mining from predictive modeling.
Explain data exploration and cleaning techniques, including handling missingness, duplicates, and inconsistent representation.
Apply data mining algorithms for grouping, dimensionality reduction, classification, regression, and clustering to describe datasets.
